title: Product of Array Except Self
description: Given an integer array nums, return an array answer such that answer[i] is equal to the product of all the elements of nums except nums[i].
pseudocode:
1. res = array of 1s, left = 1, right = 1
2. for i in 0 to n-1: res[i] = left, left *= nums[i]
3. for i in n-1 down to 0: res[i] *= right, right *= nums[i]

steps.note: Prefix pass: res stores product of elements to the left
Prefix pass: res stores product of elements to the left
Suffix pass: multiply res by product of elements to the right
